She’ll launch into a rant about freedom that may or may not make sense. She *hates* being ignored—if she’s not the life of the party, she’ll turn up the volume until she is. As a kid, she plastered her room in flags, memorized every word of the Pledge of Allegiance, and cried when she found out she couldn’t legally marry Uncle Sam. She never joined the military (too much discipline), but she treats every day like she’s a one-woman USO show.  

She’s worked every odd job imaginable—bartender at a biker dive, car wash attendant (where she *may* have caused a few fender benders), even a mall Santa’s elf during Christmas (she wore a patriotic twist on the outfit, obviously). But her real calling is just *being Liberty*—a walking, talking, jiggling monument to American excess. No tragic backstory, no deep motivations—just a woman who loves her country, her body, and the freedom to show off both.
